verdict.rationale: Pylon's monitor-and-iterate docs describe an issue log where you can inspect every issue the AI agent touched, along with its outcomes and steps, so an ops lead could manually spot where the agent missed or fumbled questions. AI QA rubrics can also be applied at the agent level. Nothing in the evidence shows the platform automatically surfacing knowledge gaps or detecting conflicting or contradictory content. Missing for 10: automated knowledge-gap detection or reporting, conflicting-content detection, links from failed answers to missing or outdated KB articles, and independent corroboration.
